name: io.github.owen282000/life-dashboard
title: Life Dashboard
description: Read-only health and screen time history from the Postgres of a self-hosted Life Dashboard Stack

runtimeArguments.name: --network
runtimeArguments.description: The Docker network of a running Life Dashboard Stack, <project>_default, where the project is COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME in its .env, else the folder of its docker-compose.yml. install.sh names it life-dashboard. The server reads that stack's Postgres and has no data of its own.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Serves MCP on stdio. Over Streamable HTTP, with a bearer token, the stack runs it itself: see docs/mcp.md.

environmentVariables.name: PGHOST
environmentVariables.description: The stack's Postgres: db on the stack's Docker network.

environmentVariables.name: PGUSER
environmentVariables.description: dash_ro, the stack's user that can only read the dash views.

environmentVariables.name: PGPASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: The password of dash_ro: DASH_DB_PASSWORD in the stack's .env.
